verdict.rationale: The skills have the agent analyze the user's own codebase and issues and return insights and suggestions. Examples include a visual report of modules worth refactoring (docs-18), diff review against standards and spec (docs-14), and triage that categorizes, verifies and writes agent-ready briefs from issue-tracker data (docs-27). The grilling skill also offers recommended answers to its questions (docs-53). However, each capability rests on a one-line description, and the insights are produced by the host agent following prompts rather than by a dedicated analytics feature. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the insight/report outputs (e.g. what the refactoring report contains), coverage of data beyond code and issues, and hands-on or independent corroboration that the insight-generating skills work as described.
